== Revised Dagobah white-border face ==
The published white-border image [http://decipher.com:80/starwars/cardlists/dagobah/dark/images/lostinspacewb.gif lostinspacewb.gif], Decipher’s Dagobah card list. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010830022719id_/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/cardlists/dagobah/dark/images/lostinspacewb.gif Internet Archive], captured 30 August 2001. supports this printing’s image and game text.
The face says “system or sector”, returns one of the starfighter’s pilots there, and uses “defense value = 0”. Existing later rulings, strategy and Easter-egg material are preserved outside this printed-face correction; this batch does not revalidate them.
Existing page names, identifiers and family navigation are preserved.
